honesty.access: anonymous only; no credential is entered, stored, or synthesized, so no premium payload can enter these artifacts
honesty.authority: this harness measures and screenshots; it scores, ranks, and judges nothing
honesty.capture_method: NOT a live `/stocks/MSFT.html` site route capture (this PR is stacked on unmerged #6831 and has never been rendered by the real build pipeline into `site/`). Instead: the real `engine.security_state.compile_security_state_failure` (owner_read_completed=False, the M1 shell) and the real committed golden MSFT fixture (`tests/fixtures/security_state/golden_msft_expected_output.json`) were each passed through the real `scripts.build_ticker_pages.build_security_state()` projection and rendered through the real `templates/ticker.html.j2` (Jinja, `ChainableUndefined` for the page vars this isolated capture does not supply). The rendered page's "Identity checks" `.dpanel` — verified by walking the parsed tree's ancestor chain to actually live inside the `#security-state` panel's own evidence dialog (`#dlg-ss-evidence` -> `.dsr-dlg-body`), not directly inside the `#security-state` `<section>` itself — was extracted with BeautifulSoup, together with the template's own inline `<style>` block and `templates/theme.css`, into a standalone harness page with no other page chrome (nav, other panels, the dialog's own open/close JS). Both the golden-MSFT panel (disclosures line only, identity PROVEN, no refusals) and the M1-shell panel (both the refusals AND disclosures lines) are stacked on one harness page, so a single capture proves every changed line at once: the round-4-review MAJOR-2 leg-description house copy, the round-4-review MAJOR-3 `.dfoot .c` chip redesign, and the round-3 MAJOR-1 chip scoping.
honesty.gaps: states that were not captured are recorded with a reason; nothing is inferred for them
honesty.light_theme_judgment: Judged as a design, not a token swap: light renders a white/near-white cool canvas (`--bg`/`--card` light tokens already defined in `templates/theme.css` for this page's other components), hairline `1px` dividers between R1..R9 receipts, and dark ink text — a materially different surface from dark's luminance-depth panel, per `research/MASTER_PRODUCT_DESIGN_SYSTEM_V1.md`'s dark=command-center / light=research-workspace split. This round's diff replaces the round-3 `.dfoot .c` no-op (`color:var(--muted)`, identical to its own parent's color) with a real bordered pill (`border:1px solid var(--hair)`, `background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--muted) 12%,transparent)`) — the same token family and `border-radius:999px` convention as the estate's other chips (`.ci-tag`, `.ss-chip`, `.schip`), never a new palette — and gives each refusal/disclosure its own line instead of one run-on paragraph. These 8 captures are the evidence that both changes read correctly as a chip in BOTH themes, not an assertion that they do.
